content: वश {%a.%} [वश् कर्तरि अच् भावे अप् वा] .²1 Subject to, influenced by, under the influence or control of, usually in <ab>comp.</ab>; शोकवशः, मृत्युवशः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Obedient, submissive, compliant. .²3 Humbled, tamed. .²4 Charmed, fascinated. .²5 Subdued by charms. .{@-शः, -शम्@} .²1 Wish, desire, will; <ls>Ait. Up. 5. 2</ls>. .²2 Power, influence, control, mastership, authority, subjection, submission; स्ववश ‘subject to oneself’, independent; परवश ‘under the influence of others’; अनयत् प्रभुशक्तिसंपदा वशमेको नृपतीननन्तरान् <ls>R. 8. 19</ls>; वशं नी, or आनी to reduce to subjection, subdue, win over; वशं गम्-इ-या <ab>&c.</ab> to become subject to, give way, yield, submit; विषमालोड्य पास्यामि मा कीचकवशं गमम् <ls>Mb. 4. 21. 48</ls>; न शुचो वशं वशिनामुत्तम गन्तुमर्हसि <ls>R. 8. 90</ls>; वशे कृ or वशीकृ to subdue, overcome, win over; to fascinate, bewitch; वशात् (<ab>abl.</ab>) is frequently used adverbially in the sense of ‘through the force, power or influence of’, ‘on account of’, ‘for the purpose of’; दैववशात्, वायुवशात्, कार्यवशात् <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Being tamed. .²4 Birth. .{@-शः@} The residence of harlots.
